meta.name: Kusum Manohar Lele
meta.description: A hair-raising tale of lies and deceit in which two divorcees, Sujata and Manohar meet at a marriage bureau in hope of a new life. Together they agree to take time to get to know each other while waiting for Manohar's divorce. However, things escalate quickly and the two begin to live together with a baby on the way but no sign of marriage on the cards and a series of lies and deceit to follow.
